newsitem.title: USA: Novavax Inc to begin Helicore dose study.
newsitem.headline: Novavax Inc to begin Helicore dose study.

text.p: Novavax Inc said Thursday it received Food and Drug Administration permission to begin a Phase II dose-escalating trial of Helicore, a drug which targets the bacteria linked to peptic ulcers.

"We expect to begin dose-response studies within 30 days in the United States," company spokesman Frank Gerardi said, adding the oral antibacterial cleared Phase I clinical studies last November with no significant adverse reactions.
The company said patients with asymptomatic Helicobacter pylori infections will be tested.
It said that in addition to their link to peptic ulcers, the bacteria can also cause antral gastritis and are thought to cause certain types of gastric cancer.
